text: Walk me through your background and what brought you to apply for this role.
Tell me about a project you're proud of and the part you personally played in it.
Describe a time you disagreed with a teammate about a technical decision. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a time you failed to deliver something you committed to. What happened, and what did you change afterward?
Describe the hardest piece of feedback you've received and what you did with it.
Tell me about a time you had to make an important decision with incomplete information and no one to ask.
How would you design a rate limiter for a public API that runs across several servers?
A service's latency doubled overnight with no deploys. Walk me through how you would investigate.
Explain a technical trade-off you made recently, and what you would choose differently today.
Your system needs to handle a hundred times its current traffic in three months. What do you change first, and why?
Explain how you would keep data consistent between two services that each own their own database.
How do you decide what to test, and how do you know when a change is tested well enough to ship?
